# 15_github_repo

**What:** The complete GitHub repository for the occupation monitor: update.py (fetches new Census months, rebuilds the site data), data/ (monthly tables by occupation and by state, code and occupation tables), docs/ (the site: index.html, occupations/states/regions/meta JSON, map files), README.md, _workflow/update.yml (goes to .github/workflows/ in the repo)

**Source:** Built from collections 03, 08, 09, 10 by _scripts/build_15_tables.py and update.py

**Vintage:** 157 rows cover 100% of employment (135 tracked occupations + 22 pooled Other rows). Updater tested end to end on 17 Nov 2026: a copy without Oct 2026 downloaded the file from census.gov and rebuilt identical output. Not yet pushed to GitHub.

**Gathered:** 17 Nov 2026; manifest written 2026-11-17 14:23Z

**Script:** update.py
